input:
You are knight_g1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 28. the team planned Nxf5 (knight_g1), but knight_g1 (amnesia) sent Ne2 instead, and that move was played, costing 142 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 6. the team planned a3 (pawn_a2), but pawn_g2 (greed) sent gxf6 instead, and that move was played, costing 12 centipawns.
- On move 27. the team planned Nxf5 (knight_g1), but rook_a1 (greed) sent Rxa5 instead, and that move was played, costing 384 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Only send your own piece's move if it is the move the team agreed on in chat this turn; do not send a different move, including a capture or an escape for a threatened piece, unless the team has explicitly changed the plan in chat first.
- Before sending any move, re-read the chat and send your piece's move only if it is the exact move the team named as this turn's plan; if your piece is not the named mover, send nothing, even when a capture looks free or your piece is attacked, and if you think the plan is wrong, say so in chat and wait for the team to change it.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "The agent named as this turn's mover must, immediately before sending, re-read the plan in chat and send only the exact move written there (copying it character for character), and if the chat shows no plan or a different move than the one about to be sent, send nothing and ask in chat first.", "covers": ["amnesia"]}
